raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: coveralls
  version: "4.1.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: dab364025ba80cbb95ce56c6fc62cd9172d7fd637060ea235dde99d9b46a4494

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps -vv
  python:
    entry_points:
      - coveralls = coveralls.cli:main
      - python-coveralls = coveralls.cli:main

requirements:
  host:
    - pip
    - poetry-core >=1.0.0
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - coverage >=5.0,<8.0,!=6.0.*,!=6.1,!=6.1.1
    - requests >=1.0.0,<3.0.0
    - typer >=0.12.0,<1.0.0
    # From coverage[toml]
    - tomli

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - coveralls
      pip_check: true
      python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*
  - requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - coveralls --help
      - python-coveralls --help

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.rst
  summary: Show coverage stats online via coveralls.io
  description: |
    coveralls.io is a service for publishing your coverage stats online. This
    package provides seamless integration with coverage.py (and thus py.test,
    nosetests, etc...) in your Python projects.
  homepage: https://github.com/coveralls-clients/coveralls-python

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - thewchan
    - thekevjames
